headline.caveat: 'tens of billions of dollars' — exact value undisclosed; up to 1 million Google Cloud TPUs, well over 1GW online in 2026

realized_to_date.caveat: Anthropic has trained/served on Google Cloud since 2023; cumulative spend undisclosed

nature_md: Announced Oct 23, 2025: Anthropic expands Google Cloud usage to as many as **one million TPUs** — the largest known TPU commitment by an external customer — bringing well over 1GW of capacity online in 2026, in a deal both parties confirmed as worth 'tens of billions of dollars.' The expansion made Google's custom silicon a genuine merchant business rather than internal-only infrastructure, and anchors one leg of Anthropic's three-cloud strategy (AWS Trainium for training scale, Google TPUs, Azure/NVIDIA). Six months later it was extended by ~3.5GW more from 2027 in the three-way Broadcom deal (see related edge).

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Multi-year cloud purchase commitment expensed as consumed; combined with the AWS ($100B/decade) and Azure ($30B) commitments, Anthropic's forward compute obligations far exceed its ~$30B run-rate — funded by revenue growth and equity raises, including from the same cloud vendors.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Google Cloud revenue/backlog as consumed (part of Cloud's +82% y/y backlog surge). Google is simultaneously ~14%-shareholder and supplier: TPU revenue from a company whose valuation gains it also books — circular in the same way as Amazon, though Google discloses far less.

events.title: Anthropic expands to up to 1M Google TPUs / >1GW in 2026 ('tens of billions')
